angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 470,989 km at 58.89 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.9818 +/- 0.0189 mas (same row, RUWE 1.23): 58.89 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.677 +/- 0.027 solar radii from Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract): 470,989 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.742 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4500 +/- 125 K from Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mayo et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-136 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-136.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.647, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-136 (pscomppars): spectral type K5.5, from Mann et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155....4M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-136 (pscomppars): [M/H] -0.02 dex, from Mayo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-136 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.7765, from Mayo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-136 (pscomppars): age 0.65 Gyr, from Mayo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-136 (pscomppars): rotation period 15 d, from Mann et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155....4M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-136 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Mayo et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..235M/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.677 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.876. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
